tips.description: These settings control how AI is used for semantic explanations and comparisons.
tips.tip1: Keep the base URL pointed to a gateway that is accessible from your machine.

tips.tip3: Pick a model that balances accuracy and latency for your workflow.

audio.title: Pronunciation
audio.description: Choose the text-to-speech provider used for word playback.

provider.label: Provider
provider.helper: Edge is free and needs no configuration. OpenAI compatible covers the OpenAI API and self-hosted wrappers such as openai-edge-tts.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.helper: Stored locally only. Generate one in the Fish Audio console.

model.label: TTS model
model.helper: S1 sounds best; the older models trade quality for speed.

voice.label: Reference ID
voice.helper: Leave empty to use the default voice.

base_url.label: Endpoint URL
base_url.helper: Base URL of the service, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or a local openai-edge-tts instance.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.helper: Sent as a Bearer token when set. Local wrappers may not need one.

model.label: Model
model.helper: Model name passed to the endpoint, e.g. tts-1 or tts-1-hd.

voice.label: Voice
voice.helper: Voice name, e.g. alloy, echo, or en-US-AndrewNeural for edge-tts wrappers.

edge.title: Edge (built-in)
edge.description: Microsoft Edge's read-aloud voices, spoken directly by the app. Free, no account or key required.

voice.label: Voice
voice.helper: Voices come from the Microsoft Edge catalog; English learners usually want an en-* voice.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.helper: Stored locally only. Generate one in your ElevenLabs profile.

voice.label: Voice ID
voice.helper: The voice id from your ElevenLabs voice library.

model.label: Model
model.helper: Model id, e.g. eleven_multilingual_v2 or eleven_turbo_v2_5.

anki.title: AnkiConnect
anki.description: Send curated cards directly to your deck via the AnkiConnect plugin.

api_url.label: API address
api_url.helper: Default AnkiConnect endpoint. Change it only if you use a custom address.

deck.label: Deck name
deck.helper: Cards are saved into this deck. You can pick any existing or new deck.

card_theme.label: Card theme
card_theme.helper: Choose whether cards render with a light or dark canvas.

why.title: Why cache?
items: The dictionary data is stored locally to enable fast lookups without internet access.
Re-download only if the cache becomes corrupted or outdated.

missing.title: Download the dictionary
missing.description: The offline dictionary hasn't been downloaded yet. Download it now to look up words without an internet connection?

incomplete.description: The local dictionary cache contains only {{count}} entries. A full cache should have at least {{required}} entries. Do you want to re-download the cache now?

toast.check_incomplete: Dictionary cache may be incomplete ({{count}} entries, expected more than {{required}}).

usage.title: Usage

New query: Clear the search and start fresh.
